agenda_text:
COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS AGENDA
  SATURDAY, OCTOBER 19, 2024
  3820 CHERRY AVENUE
  MILLER FAMILY HEALTH EDUCATION CENTER, 9:30 AM

Samantha Mehlinger, Chair  Helena Donato-Sapp, Commissioner
Zoe Nicholson, Vice Chair  Maria Gonzalez, Commissioner
Jennifer Allen Harper, Commissioner  Maleka Lassiter, Commissioner
Dr. Stephanie Anckle, Commissioner  Alyce LaViolette, Commissioner
Irma Archuleta, Commissioner  Vanessa Mosqueda, Commissioner
Sathya Chey Patterson, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING (RETREAT)

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  ALANAH.GRANT@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

WELCOME AND INTRODUCTION

1.  24-55308  Recommendation to discuss the goals and aspirations of the Commission to inform
  the Commission for Women and Girls Vision Map Priorities.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-55309  Recommendation to discuss potential Ad Hoc Committees and, if appropriate, take
  action to establish any Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Commission for Women and Girls on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact he Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.

1.  24-55308  Recommendation to discuss the goals and aspirations of the Commission to inform
  the Commission for Women and Girls Vision Map Priorities.

  A motion was made by Commissioner LaViolette, seconded by Commissioner
  Chey Patterson, to approve recommendation. No vote was taken on the
  motion.

  A substitute motion was made by Chair Mehlinger, seconded by
  Commissioner Mosqueda, to adopt the following goals of the Commission: [1]
  to create a mentorship program that empowers women and girls in Long
  Beach with access to economic opportunities; and [2] to create and develop a
  conference that focuses on building healthy families and empowers women
  and girls. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  10 Allen Harper, Anckle, Archuleta, Chey Patterson, Donato-Sapp,
  Gonzalez, Lassiter, LaViolette, Mosqueda, Mehlinger
  No:  0 None

A motion was made by Commissioner LaViolette, seconded by Commissioner
Gonzalez, to approve recommendation, as amended, to [a] create the
following Ad Hoc Committees: [1] Safety Ad Hoc Committee, whose
members are Commissioner Archuleta, Commissioner Donato-Sapp,
Commissioner Lassiter, Commissioner LaViolette and Chair Mehlinger; [2]
Communications and Outreach Ad Hoc Committee, whose members are
Commissioner Anckle, Commissioner Lassiter, Commissioner LaViolette,
Commissioner Mosqueda and Chair Mehlinger; [3] Mentorship and Education
Ad Hoc Committee, whose members are Commissioner Allen Harper,
Commissioner Chey Patterson, Commissioner Lassiter, Commissioner
Mosqueda and Chair Mehlinger; and [b] add the following members to the
Bylaws Ad Hoc Committee: Commissioner Anckle, Commissioner Archuleta
and Commissioner Gonzalez. The motion carried by the following vote:
